render.colour: near-white / light grey, low saturation, dark outline

colour_census_dummy_window_pts_6000_6002.reading: green is the character.LogData debug overlay plus foliage; red is world/blood. No saturated numeral class exists. Direct damage and DoT are NOT separable by colour.

render.scale_behaviour: spawns small, GROWS to peak over ~0.5 s, then fades. Observed ink 110 -> 307 and width 33 -> 66 px over frames 8..36 of a 60 fps burst at pts 6046.13-6046.60.
render.spatial_semantics: per TARGET (independent numbers at each of two dummies' screen positions) AND multiple numbers per target within ~0.2 s, i.e. per damage COMPONENT, not one per swing.

why_census_fails: SNR: naive bright+achromatic detection over a 10 s dummy window (pts 6044-6054) yields 298 tracked candidates against a true count of order 10-30. Wet-rock specular, torchlight and bone props are the same colour, same size and equally transient.
The green character.LogData overlay renders in exactly the region FCT spawns (over the target) at the same 10-16 px glyph height; its anti-aliased edges pass the brightness test.
Numbers OVERLAP each other. At pts 6046.60 three numbers overlap; only the topmost ('449') is legible, the other two are mutually destroyed.
Multi-scale life plus camera pan defeats naive centroid tracking; instances fragment and are multiply counted.
fct_instrument.v2_recommendation: Record a dedicated dummy segment with character.LogData OFF. That removes the single largest confound and makes the census tractable. Keep the overlay ON for the swing-count segment where it is the instrument.

damage_per_second_field.kind: ROLLING-WINDOW MEAN, not instantaneous and not cumulative
damage_per_second_field.evidence: pts 6046-6052: a ~1 s damage burst produces a 6.0-6.5 s non-zero plateau that then drops to 0.00 in one step. Bout onsets ramp monotonically (97.42 -> 171.54 -> 357.32 -> 519.55 ...) and offsets decay smoothly.
damage_per_second_field.consequence: integral(dps dt) over a whole bout equals TOTAL DAMAGE DEALT in that bout, with no per-hit census required. This is the usable outgoing-damage instrument.
damage_per_second_field.sampling: 2 fps panel OCR; trapezoid integration; None values forward-filled (3 of 180 samples in range)

devotion_control.verdict: NOT VERIFIED off a still. Remains OPEN.

devotion_control.strongest_indirect_evidence: Across all 313 native screenshots the Skills Used list contains exactly six paths -- default/defaultkickattack, default/defaultweaponattack, playerclass10/onslaught, playerclass10/werewolf1, playerclass10/werewolf1_skill01_claws, playerclass10/werewolf1_skill02_charge. NO devotion/ path ever appears.
devotion_control.what_that_does_and_does_not_prove: It proves no devotion PROC skill fired in 118 minutes, which closes the unattributed-kill channel that motivated the control. It does NOT prove zero points assigned: stat-only constellation nodes proc nothing and would leave no trace here.
devotion_control.recommendation: v2 protocol: screenshot the devotion screen at run start and run end. Converts a believed control into a verified one for the cost of two keystrokes.

corrections_to_gandalf_round_2_note: The dummy test is at LEVEL 11, not just-before-12. max level 10 -> 11 happens at pts 5515.0, at the start of the no-kill window, not inside it.
The no-kill window is wider than bracketed: 96:48 to 107:55 play_time, 667 s, not 98:12-106:11.
The offset-5800 node grid is the MASTERY tree, not devotion. Devotion remains unverified.

Regen does NOT need an out-of-combat recovery stretch at matched level and gear. The panel life_healed delta gives it exactly, in-window, at the same instant, because the no-potion control removes the only exogenous term and zero dps removes lifesteal.

FCT and the rolling dps field cannot cross-validate as posed, because the FCT census is not extractable at this capture. The dps field is nevertheless a complete outgoing-damage instrument on its own once you recognise it as a rolling mean and integrate it.
